build.compiler_version:
Apple clang version 17.0.0 (clang-1700.4.4.1)
Target: arm64-apple-darwin25.6.0
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Toolchains/XcodeDefault.xctoolchain/usr/bin

dataset.encoding: strict ASCII128, one byte per token

limitations: Fixed development budget experiment, not a final-test or significance result.
Validation windows24..39 differ from v1 windows8..23; their scores are not paired.
Matched controls are refitted separately at256 and1024 updates; none at initialization.
The same131072 training pairs and2048 validation positions are reused across six cells.
LUT-normalized NLL is not ordinary softmax perplexity or the exact surrogate derivative.
Native validation arrays are recomputed; native routes are checked against saved hashes.
Training arrays are hash/coverage verified, not independently replayed every step.
The audit reuses the host observer; this is not outside-group reproduction.
No new silicon, accelerator speed, energy or cost-to-quality result.
Binary artifacts are local and ignored; fresh clones need these or complete reruns.

recipe.baseline: alpha=1,128 symbols; target counts and within-window token-target pairs only
recipe.checkpoint_256_policy: complete actual bytes must equal corresponding v1 arm/seed

head_initialization.anchors: retain jitter at (5*v+seed)%512, subtract8192 elsewhere; zshift=4

recipe.initialization_policy: from original initialization; never resume a v1 checkpoint
recipe.mechanism_evaluation: final validation, separately for every seed
recipe.projection_initialization: unchanged original LCG jitter for every cell
recipe.scope: six-cell fixed CPU/CSIM budget extension; no adaptive extension, hardware execution, ordinary softmax perplexity, statistical significance or speed claims
recipe.validation_cohort: new development windows24..39, not v1 paired scores or final test
